Resolves #21144
Related: #21140, #21411

Added a live, copyable **Code** panel (`examples/workbench/CodeView.mjs`, `examples/workbench/formatConfig.mjs`, wired from `examples/ConfigurationViewport.mjs` and `resources/css/src/examples/ConfigurationViewport.css`), displaying `module` and literal changed configs as evaluable Neo config (omitting functions and live `Neo.core.Base` instances as descriptive comment lines) with one-click clipboard copy (`Copy`) and automatic clearing on `Reset`.

change-class: capability
agent-preflight: not hosted here; check-examples-body-only + unit + whitebox-e2e ran on d2bed22d2f
Evidence: L3 (Playwright unit + Neural Link whitebox E2E + live 1440x900 & 390x844 Chrome captures) -> L3 required (AC1-AC7). Residual: AC8, AC9, Residual-Owner: #21411.

## Deltas from ticket
- Split Part 2 (`State in the URL` — AC-8 & AC-9) into post-cut successor #21411 (`blocked_by #21144`, `parent_child` under #21140) per #21144's 18 Nov re-cut so Engine 14 ships Part 1 cleanly.
- Extracted the code panel into `examples/workbench/CodeView.mjs` (`Neo.examples.workbench.CodeView`, reactive `code_` config owning DOM sync and clipboard copy) and pure serialization helpers into `examples/workbench/formatConfig.mjs`. Non-literal changed configs (`Function`, `NeoInstance`, or nested non-literal values) are omitted from object properties with `// <key>: ... not shown` comments rather than stubbed as no-ops.
- Subscribed reactive configs via `observeConfig()` alongside base inspector handlers so subclass overrides mutating `exampleComponent` directly (`button/base`'s `ui` selector) and root `set()` calls (`functional/nestedComponents`) update the Code View automatically.
- Documented `resolveControlConfigKey()` convention (`name` -> camel-cased `labelText` / `valueLabel`), registered `core/WorkbenchCodeViewNL.spec.mjs` in `test/playwright/externalBrainSelection.mjs` (`ADAPTER_ELIGIBLE_SPECS`), and kept `internalExampleConfigs` covering creation structures plus reactive core lifecycle flags (`isDestroying_`, `isReady_`, `isVdomUpdating_`, `mounted_`).

- **Cold reader 2 (`Design 1 = changed`, `Design 2 = released`):** Design 1 **7/10**, Design 2 **6/10** — verdict: **Design 1 is better** (complete preview → edit → copy-code workflow on both desktop and mobile while keeping stage at top; flags same mobile mid-row scroll boundary at `iconCls`, hidden desktop `FLAGS` overflow below `disabled`, and tight pre-existing radio spacing).

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:** #21144 (design authority: the operator's direction of 16 Nov, #21140's target; Part 1 is the code view, Part 2 is the URL state after the cut), Maryam's claim comment and #21411 (the split), `dev`'s `examples/ConfigurationViewport.mjs` (580 lines: stage, inspector, snapshot and reset), `src/component/Base.mjs#text_`, and the engine's copy precedent `src/form/field/trigger/CopyToClipboard.mjs` (`DomAccess.selectNode` + `execCommand('copy')`).
